en.sayed-ali-raza: Then I said to him, “Moaning women may moan over you, O ‘Aqīl.
Do you cry on account of this (heated) iron which has been made by a man for fun while you are driving me towards the fire which Allāh, the Powerful, has prepared for (a manifestation of) His wrath?
Should you cry from pain, but I should not cry from the flames?”
